simple.meaning: to turn about or over; by implication, to change , overturn , return , pervert
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הָפַךְ (H2015) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 94 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הָפַךְ (hâphak) means to turn about or over; by implication, to change , overturn , return , pervert First listed occurrence: 1Chr 19 3.

definitions.short: to turn about or over; by implication, to change , overturn , return , pervert
definitions.usage: × become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).
definitions.full: H2015. haphak הָפַךְ verb turn, overturn (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic הֲפַךְ , , Arabic W SG 47 , Assyrian abâku, apâku Dl W ) — Qal Perfect Lev 13:3 13 t.; וְהָפַךְ consecutive 2Kin 21:13 ; Job 34:25 ; 3 masculine plural הָֽפְכוּ Psa 78:9 ; הֲפַכְתֶּם Amos 6:12 ; Jer 23:36 , etc.; Imperfect יַהֲפֹךְ Lam 3:3 ; Jer 13:23 ; וַיַּהֲפֹךְ Gen 19:25 6 t.; וַיַּהֲפָךְֿ 1Sam 10:9 ; suffix וַיַּהַפְכֵהוּ Judg 7:13 ; 3 feminine singular וַתַּהֲפֹךְ 2Chr 9:12 ; אֶהְמֹּךְ Zeph 3:9 ; וַיַּהַפְכוּ 1Sam 25:12 ; Job 12:15 ; Imperative הֲפֹךְ 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 ; Infinitive absolute הָפוֺךְ Prov 12:7 ; construct הֲפֹךְ Gen 19:29 ; 1Chr 19:3 ; suffix הָפְכִּי Gen 19:21 ; הָפְכָהּ 2Sam 10:3 ; — on הַפְכְּכֶם (so Baer, q. v.) Isa 29:16 , see הֶפֶךְ ; Participle active הֹפֵךְ Amos 5:8 ; הַהֹפְכִי Psa 114:8 ; plural הַהֹפְכִים Amos 5:7 ; passive הֲפוּכָה Hosea 7:8 ; Lam 4:6 . — 1 transitive a. turn, turn about, turn over , with accusative: e.g. turn the back ( עֹרֶף ) Josh 7:8 (JE); a dish ( צַלַּחַת ) עַלמָּֿנֶיהָ 2Kin 21:13 ; the hand, & so the horses of a chariot 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 ; 2Kin 9:23 ; but also (followed by בְּ ) of hostility Lam 3:3 ; turn a cake (passive) Hosea 7:8 ; of ׳ה בְּרוּרָה שָׂפָה ׳י, Zeph 3:9 i.e. restore speech of a pure kind, followed by אֶלעַֿמִּים ; אַחֵר לֵב 1Sam 10:9 another heart , followed by לוֺ ; turn a wind ( רוּחַ ; i.e. bring from different quarter) Exod 10:19 (J). b. overturn, overthrow , followed by accusative Sodom, etc., Gen 19:21 , 25 , 29 (J), Deut 29:22 ; Jer 20:16 ; Lam 4:6 (compare וגו ׳מַהְמֵּכַת Amos 4:11 see below; also הֲפֵכָה , [ מַהְמֵּכָה ]); city of Ammon 2Sam 10:3 = 1Chr 19:3 (object omitted); mountains Job 9:5 ; 28:9 ; throne Hag 2:22 (|| הִשְׁמִיד ), chariots 2:22 ; tent ( אֹהֶל ), ׳ה לְמַ֫עְלָה Judg 7:3 ; object earth ( ׳ה = devastate ) Job 12:15 ; wicked men Amos 4:11 ( וְאֶתֿ אֶתסְֿדֹם אֱלֹהִים כְּמַהְמֵּכַת בָּכֶם הָפַכְּתִּי יֲמֹרָה ) Prov 12:7 ; Job 34:25 (object omitted). c. turn = change, transform (1) followed by accusative = alter ; a colour ( עֵינוֺ ) Lev 13:55 (P); skin Jeremiah 13:33; bed ( מִשְׁכָּבוֺ see ׳מ ; Che his lying down ) Psa 41:4 i.e. restore to health; (2) pervert אֱלֹהִים דִבְרֵי Jer 23:36 ; (3) followed by accusative with Infinitive Psa 105:25 he turned their heart to hate his people ; (4) turn to, into , followed by two accusative Lev 13:10 ; Psa 114:8 rock into pool of water; usually followed by accusative + לְ , 66:6 sea into dry land, 78:44 rivers into blood, compare 105:29 ; Jer 31:13 mourning into joy, so Psa 30:12 ; Amos 5:7 justice into wormwood, compare 6:12 ; 8:10 feasts into mourning; Deut 23:6 = Neh 13:2 curse into blessing; Amos 5:8 death-shade into morning. 2 intransitive a. turn, turn back , Judg 20:39 , 41 ; 2Kin 5:26 ; Psa 78:9 ; 2Chr 9:12 ; followed by לדרך 1Sam 25:12 ; b. turn = change, change into , followed by predicate adjective ׳ה לָבָן turn white Lev 13:3-4 , 13 , 20 (all P). Niph`al Perfect נֶהְמַּךְ Exod 7:15 10 t.; נֶהְמָּ֑ךְ Job 20:14 ; וְנֶהְמַּךְ consecutive Lev 13:16 ; נֶהֶפְכָה Lam 5:2-3 ;masculine plural נֶהְמְּכוּ Job 19:19 3 t., נֶהֶפְכוּ 1Sam 4:19 ; Dan 10:16 , וְנֶהֶפְכוּ consecutive Exod 7:17 ; Isa 34:9 , etc.; Imperfect יֵהָפֵךְ 60:5 ; Joel 3:4 ; וַיֵּהָפֵךְ Exod 14:5 ; Isa 63:10 ; 2 masculine singular תֵּהָפֵךְ Job 30:21 ; Ezek 4:8 ; וַיֵּהָֽפְכוּ Exod 7:20 ; Infinitive absolute נַהֲפוֺךְ Est 9:1 ; Participle נֶהְמָּךְ Prov 17:20 ; נֶהְמָּ֑כֶת Jonah 3:4 ; — 1 reflexive & intrans . a. turn oneself, turn, turn back (compare Qal 2 a ) Josh 8:20 (JE); turn aside Psa 78:57 ; turn from side to side Ezek 4:8 ; pains turned upon ( עַל ) her 1Sam 4:19 (i.e. came suddenly upon her) compare Dan 10:16 ; turn against followed by בְּ Job 19:19 ; turn to ( ward ), followed by עַל , Isa 60:5 (|| לְ בא ). b. turn = change (oneself) followed by predicate adjective Lev 13:25 (P); followed by predicate noun (?), vine turns into degenerate plant Jer 2:21 ; no predicate expressed Job 20:14 (compare v b ); of heart turned in compassion Hosea 11:8 (|| נִחוּמָ֑י נִכְמְרוּ ), in sorrow, distress, Lam 1:20 ; of heart changed, so as to be favourably disposed toward (followed by אֶל ) Exod 14:5 (J) = change of mind; followed by לְ , of plague spots changing colour Lev 13:16-17 , (P); rod changing to serpent Exod 7:15 (P); faces to paleness Jer 30:6 ; dance to mourning Lam 5:15 ; comeliness to corruption Dan 10:8 ; לְאוֺיֵב לָהֶם וַיֵּהָפֵךְ Isa 63:10 ; Job 30:21 . c. be perverse , only participle used substantive בִּלְשׁוֺנוֺ נֶהְמָּךְ Prov 17:20 he that is perverse with his tongue. 2 passive, a. be turned, turned over to followed by לְ , an inheritance to strangers Lam 5:2 . b. be reversed Est 9:1 . c. be turned, changed , followed by לְ , waters into blood Exod 7:17 , 20 (E); Saul into another man 1Sam 10:6 ; streams into pitch Isa 34:9 ; sun to darkness Joel 3:4 ; stones to chaff Job 41:20 ; month changed from sorrow to gladness Est 9:22 ; compare Psa 32:4 where complement omitted d. be overturned, overthrown , of city Nineveh Jonah 3:4 . e. be upturned , of subterran. work of miners Job 28:5 = there is an upturning. Hithpa`el Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּתְהַמֵּךְ Job 38:14 ; Participle מִתְהַמֵּךְ Judg 7:13 ; Job 37:12 ; מִתְהַמֶּכֶת Gen 3:24 ; — reflexive & intransitive: 1 turn this way & that, every way , of the flaming sword Gen 3:24 (J); storm-cloud Job 37:12 ; turn over & over Judg 7:13 , of bread-cake tumbling into the host of Midian. 2 transform oneself , Job 38:14 of earth under rising dawn. Hoph`al Perfect בַּלָּהוֺת עָלַי הָהְמַּךְ Job 30:15 there have been turned upon me terrors (compare הִתְגַּלְגָּ֑לוּ 30:14 , of foes).
